lines.text: Sly has noticed a fresher.
Has the fresher noticed the toll?
…Sorry.
Sly will remember your face.
In a good way. Maybe.
Sly is not afraid. Sly is… beside you.
Sly keeps his word. No tax. This year.
That is nothing. That is for… dogs.
Zobo Max. You'll need it one day. Sly knows things.
I didn't think anyone would train for it.
Sly did that. Not the boy. Sly did that.
Sir! Half a haircut is against the profession!
It needs a code name. 'Operation Sly.'
Sly tied it. With feelings. It will hold.
…Sly is not crying. It is dust. From the cellar.
Sly's father had a shop. A small one.
Tell nobody Sly is gentle with wood. Sly has a brand.
…Sly was holding a rung. In his TEETH.
Half a tower. Best view on campus. Sly approves.
Sly is not in. Bolaji is in. Shop is closed.
For sterilisation. Sorry, knuckles.
Sly does not wait for sleep!
Bolaji also does not wait. He is just polite.
Tradition. Who told him it was tradition?
They leave out the part where I cried in a salon.
Watch my back. And carry one thing.
Sly was a bully. Bolaji is a barber. Sly is retired.
If you see Sly, tell him Big Baby is looking for him.
I'm finished, I'm finished.
Strong hands. I need a boy at the shop. Monday.
Well done, John Carter.
Sly would have charged for that paint.
Professor. You cannot requisition a favour.
You have to go and greet people.
Not me. If I had a sweet, I would have eaten it.
Sly has made tea. One of us is useful.
Professor. Breathe first. Lecture second.
Sly does not ride at night. Bolaji rides. Get on.
Shop is closed. No haircut. No entry. Next.
Congratulations… Abbas.
Don't cry, John Car— Abbas. I am practising.
Sly sees you. Sly nods. That is a big honour.
E kaaro! [Good morning!] Sly has been awake since five. Pushing iron.
Ah, the fresher. Not a fresher. You know what Sly means.
You. Yes, you. …Sly is just greeting. Relax your shoulders.
Go well. Walk like Sly. Chest first.
Bye. Sly will wave. …Sly has waved.
Sly says thank you. Quietly. Tell nobody.
You did well. Sly will crack one knuckle for you. Sorry, knuckle.
Sly bumped you. Sly is a building. Buildings apologise too.
Sorry. Sly's voice is loud even when Sly is sorry.
Your shape is improving. Coach Ngozi will be proud. Sly is proud.
That haircut is clean. Who did it? …Sly did it. Of course.
You walk like a man carrying garri up five floors. Lift the knees.
Small arms. Big heart. We can fix the arms.
Sly is behind you. Like a wardrobe that loves you.
Walk. Sly will clear the path. Nobody stands in front of a wardrobe.
Sly has done forty press-ups waiting for you. Forty-one.
Hurry. Sly is patient but Sly's knees are not.
That is the road to Theatre Yamma. You want Gabas. Everybody does that.
Sly agrees. Write it down.
No. Sly has spoken. …Unless Big Baby says yes.
Maybe. Sly will ask Big Baby and report back.
Sly is thinking. It is loud in there. Give me a minute.
Why is the dumbbell sad? Nobody lifts its mood. …Sly wrote that.
You have eaten? Muscles are built at the Spot, not in the gym.
SLY! Sorry. Bolaji. …Both of us won.
Sly lost. Sly will now sit on the bench and reflect. Loudly.
Sly is fine. The ground is fine. Everybody is fine.
You pushed Sly. Brave. Wrong, but brave.
Sly is not on the floor. Sly is inspecting the floor.
NEPA has taken the light. Sly will lift in the dark. Sly fears nothing. Mostly.
Light! Turn on the clippers before it changes its mind!
Rain on the court. Today Sly trains in the corridor of Giginya.
This sun. Even Sly's muscles are sweating.
Mama Nkechi's beans. Protein. And love. Mostly protein.
Sly does not collect money any more. Sly collects compliments.
For Sly? Sly will keep it on the barber's mirror.
Thank you. Sly will give it to Abbas. He likes strange things.
Zobo Max, cold. You remembered. …It is dust. In my eye. From the court.
One. Two. Three hundred. Sly counts fast.
Knuckles, crack. …Sorry, knuckles. You have done nothing wrong.
At night Sly walks softly. Hostel people are sleeping. Or reading. Sorry.
You trained for the spar. Nobody trains for Sly. Sly still talks about it.
Here. Zobo Max. Sly said you'd need it one day.
Fresher! Have you noticed the toll? …There is no toll. Sly promised.
This is Sly's court. You can walk on it. Politely.
Sly has a reputation. Sly is ironing it.
Hassan says freshers fear Sly. Good. Sly fears Big Baby. That is the chain.
You paid two hundred? Ah. Sly can't give it back. Sly ate it.
You stood up three times. Sly noticed. Sly notices everything.
Big Baby said one word to Sly that day. Sly is still recovering.
That night in the dark with the torches. Sly was beside you. Not behind.
Ten seconds on the bench and you came back! Sly respects a comeback.
Sly does not like the dam road at night. Sly is not scared. It is just… long.
Welcome to Sly's Cuts. First cut, free. Second cut, also free. Sly is new at this.
You came back! A returning customer! Sly is crying. It is shaving dust.
Sly painted the sign himself. The S is backwards. It is a style.
Three customers today. Malam Garba twice. He only said 'Hm.'
First man in the chair was Malam Garba. Hands like bread. Gentle like bread.
Abbas gave the fade nine and a half. Sly will frame the score card.
Half a haircut in a blackout. Sly finished it by phone torch. Never again.
Operation Sly. Nobody uses the name. Sly uses it. In the mirror.
Hold still. Sly is giving you a cut that passes exams.
Your hairline is going on strike before the lecturers.
Iron Mama is loud. Sly is louder. Keep walking.
Sly is in the workshop. Do not tell people about the sawdust.
Sly is gentle with wood. Sly has a brand. Keep it between us.
The foreman says measure twice. Sly measured four times. Sly is nervous.
My father had a shop. Small. It smelled like this.
Half a tower. Best view on campus. Sly approves. Sly will not climb it again.
Sly held a rung in his teeth. You don't forget the taste of a ladder.
Strike month five. Sly has cut every head on campus twice. Even the goat's.
You sat down for three weeks. Your chair is shaped like you now.
Lamp's working. Sly built the box. Abbas did the wires. Teamwork.
Gym. Six o'clock. Sly does not wait for sleep! …Bolaji is polite.
Jega did one more lap than yesterday. Sly will tell nobody. Sly will tell everybody.
Helen's exercise sheet has a column for excuses. Sly filled it. Sly was told off.
Slow is still forward. Coach Ngozi said that. Sly stole it.
Jega didn't come that morning. You found him. Sly saw. Good man.
The Lucky boy wanted Sly in his video. Shop was closed. Sly is proud.
Your arms have arrived. Welcome, arms.
Pool today. Too hot for the court. Even Sly melts.
You lifted that like it owed you money. Good. Again.
Ah, final year. Sly will give you a finalist's fade. Very serious. Very employed.
Sly was a bully. Bolaji is a barber. Sly is retired. Sly visits sometimes.
If you see Sly, tell him Big Baby is looking for him.
Five hundred naira from freshers. Who told that boy it was tradition?
The boy works at the shop now. Strong hands. He sweeps like a king.
Sly made tea for the Build Week. One of us was useful.
You don't need Sly to watch your back any more. Sly will watch it anyway.
Professor Shamsu came for a cut. Sly gave him 'Simple.' It was not simple.
After convocation, come back. Sly's chair. Free. For life. Don't tell Hassan.
No fresher pays on Sly's court. Not this year. Not any year.
Freshers! Your first cut is on Sly. Look sharp for matric.
Exam week. Sly is reading. The pages are scared of Sly.
Sly has a carry-over. Again. Sly and the carry-over are now family.
Sly passed Thermodynamics! It only took four attempts! Thermodynamics is tired.
Allowance week! Every head wants a cut. Sly has three combs ready.
Market day. Big Baby's salon, then Sly's chair. One street, all the fashion.
Education! Education! Sly does not study Education. Sly shouts for Jega.
Sly will vote for the person whose hair Sly cut last. That is democracy.
Sly practised all week. A-b-b-a-s. Sly can say it now. Mostly.
Sly is carrying pots for the iftar kitchen. Two at once. Ask me for three.
Campus is empty. Sly is cutting hair for everyone travelling home. Look fresh for Mama.
Sly bought Big Baby one rose. She said 'Bolaji.' Sly is still deciding what it meant.
Harmattan. Sly's skin is dry like a lecture at eight. Pass the shea butter.
